title: Calling "append_import_external_resource" in an EditorImportPlugin make reimported resources not emitting "Resource.changed"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.1.stable, 4.8.dev6, 4.6.stable

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2560x1440 @ 180.06 Hz, 2560x1440 @ 144.00 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 31.84 GiB memory - WASAPI (96000 Hz, Surround 7.1)

### Issue description

When creating a Plugin, having 2 `EditorImportPlugin` (lets call them A and B), if A use `append_import_external_resource` to reimport another resource B during its own import, A `Resource.changed` signal does not get emitted in the editor (therefor, any tool script that rely on this event to update something do not get notified).

Note: After further testing, you don't event need to reimport another resource with a custom EditorImportPlugin. Reimporting the initial icon.svg react the same (calling `append_import_external_resource("res://icon.svg")`).

Edit: When the project is running, changed do get called (you can run the scene and reimport and you will get the print again, but just in the running project no in the tool script that keep running with the game)

Edit 2: After further more testing, I discovered that values in the resource does not get updated in the editor too while still getting saved in the .tres file, I've updated the MRP and here is a small video to show this behavior :

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/089256cd-49b6-417c-90f3-3a14b4c4c680

### Steps to reproduce

- Create an `EditorPlugin`
- Create a simple `EditorImportPlugin`
- Add the import plugin on `_enter_tree` in your `EditorPlugin`
- Call `append_import_external_resource` on any other resource in your `EditorImportPlugin` _import function
- Create a resource of the extension of your `EditorImportPlugin`
- Create a scene with a tool script attached to it that load your resource and connect a function to its changed signal
- Reload your scene, try to reimport your resource in the editor and see that your function does not get called. Comment the line `append_import_external_resource` and see that your function now get called.


In the MRP project:
- Open the demo scene and try to reimport res.test
- Comment the line 45 `append_import_external_resource("res://addons/test/res2.test2")` in `res://addons/test/import_res.gd`
- reimport res.test, it should now print in the Output

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MrpChangedNotEmitted_update.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32798172/MrpChangedNotEmitted_update.zip)
